title: DEADPOINT
description:
WELCOME TO DEADPOINTYou are a scavenger. You must survive in this apocalyptic world infested with zombies.

Deadpoint is a third-person open world survival game. Players must explore the open world to gather resources to survive and fight against zombies and wild animals. Work with NPC traders to buy items or complete quests for rewards.

EXPLOREExplore the open world of DEADPOINT. With vast environment featuring forests, towns, villages, and more. Find vehicles to help you traverse the map.

GEAR UPFind houses and buildings, chop trees with axe, gear yourself with armour and weapons, and gather as much resources as you can. You can also trade with traders.

KILL OR GET KILLED.The world is infested with zombies. You can find various weapons from long to close ranged to help you survive against the zombies and wild animals. 

DEFEND YOURSELF Always be careful. You can build protections in your house with wood by baricading them. However, you will need a tool. 

SURVIVEMaintain your health, hunger, thirst, and stamina. These elements are crucial to your survival. You can hunt animals to get food, and find rags as a bandage, or buy them from traders.
description_short: "Deadpoint" is an engaging third-person survival game set in an apocalyptic world overrun by zombies. Players take on the role of a resourceful scavenger, tasked with navigating the dangerous landscape and ensuring their survival amid the hordes of undead.
